name: autoratchet
description: Prevent code complexity regressions, one pull request at a time. A threshold-aware ratchet on cyclomatic and cognitive complexity for TypeScript, JavaScript and Rust, compared against your target branch, with no baseline file to maintain.
author: Jag Reehal

scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-cargo-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.format: cargo fmt && oxfmt bin scripts conformance/run.ts conformance/bench.ts
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --check && oxfmt --check bin scripts conformance/run.ts conformance/bench.ts
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm test
